claimLedger.claim: AMH and antral follicle count estimate reserve and predict stimulation response; they do not measure egg quality or reliably predict natural conception.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ASRM ReproductiveFacts · Testing and interpreting measures of ovarian reserve
claimLedger.limitations: Reserve markers need interpretation with age and clinical context.

claimLedger.claim: Avoid smoking, keep a healthy weight, limit alcohol, moderate caffeine; age is the major factor in fertility.
claimLedger.limitations: General associations do not prove that a specific change improves egg quality.

claimLedger.claim: Evaluation after 12 months (under 35) or 6 months (35 and over), earlier with risk factors; tests selected clinically.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ASRM Practice Committee · Fertility evaluation of infertile women: a committee opinion
claimLedger.limitations: Does not endorse a universal supplement or testing package.
